title: Initial decorated configuration
statement: Let $P$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $A$, let $l$ be a natural number, choose a work-tape index $h$ of $P$, a finite data-state set $D$ with initial state $d_0$, and any visit function of the specified type. For every input word $x$, the decorated machine's initial configuration on $x$ is the decorated configuration formed from $P$'s initial configuration, data state $d_0$, blank contents on all extra tapes, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is finite and has decidable equality
$P$ is a finite Turing machine over $A$
The visit function has the stated type
replaced:
Let $P$ be a machine over an alphabet $A$, decorated by a data transducer with $l$
extra tapes, designated head index $h$, a finite data-state set with initial element
$d_0$, and a visit function.  For every input word $x$, the initial configuration of
the decorated machine on $x$ equals the decorated configuration built from the
initial configuration of $P$ on $x$, the initial data state $d_0$, entirely blank
extra tapes, and the empty output: the data tapes begin blank and aligned with the
schedule's origin.
